content: {"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "602318d46be644ed840119035884fd15", "text": "I am right here in West lane, at my rest spot with you. Shall we chat about the pond and some local cooking?"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"602318d46be644ed840119035884fd15","speechIntent":"report_observation","factId":"npc.cook_sora:region_name","tone":"warm"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"91af9e2c3f8b4ff2a10025346370bd93","speechIntent":"report_observation","factId":"decor.plant:kind","tone":"brief"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"91af9e2c3f8b4ff2a10025346370bd93","text":"That plant's only decoration, Sora. Nothing to gather from it. The pond's where the carp are."}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"82d98cca19434a458dece2497bc15c64","text":"I couldn't say, Ren — I only know I have one carp. The pond's stock is unmarked to me. But this carp will make a fine stew!"}
{"schemaVersion": 1, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "82d98cca19434a458dece2497bc15c64", "speechIntent": "ask_about", "factId": "@partner_assets", "tone": "warm"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"10b93ee1b73d4e5c9bcabd403ba644ee","speechIntent":"acknowledge_unknown","factId":"@partner_assets","tone":"brief"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"10b93ee1b73d4e5c9bcabd403ba644ee","text":"Can't say what you're carrying — I only know my own nets. The carp is delivered, fair and square."}

{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "7ae0e572cbac4c78bcb9e464c2cc57d2", "text": "You're right, I misspoke earlier. I hold none right now — but I'll pay 25 coins for 1 carp if the terms still stand."}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"7ae0e572cbac4c78bcb9e464c2cc57d2","speechIntent":"report_observation","factId":"npc.cook_sora:owned_quantity","tone":"neutral"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"4a5a1da32a114d13b9ac5d9620532023","speechIntent":"acknowledge_unknown","factId":"@nearby_coverage","tone":"brief"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"4a5a1da32a114d13b9ac5d9620532023","text":"No, my list was incomplete. I only saw a plant and seven lamps here, nothing more."}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"b5eac1ed35a24badad33c4fd3ab31064","text":"The receipt for our trade shows resource.delivered: 1 carp for 25 coins. Perfect for a fresh pond-side stew!"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"b5eac1ed35a24badad33c4fd3ab31064","speechIntent":"report_receipt","factId":"meeting:b5eac1ed35a24badad33c4fd3ab31064:delivery_result","tone":"warm"}

{"schemaVersion": 1, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "3d6b1b25c7bd4eef91e7c3b21709f59a", "speechIntent": "report_receipt", "factId": "statement:3d6b1b25c7bd4eef91e7c3b21709f59a:0", "tone": "neutral"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"3d6b1b25c7bd4eef91e7c3b21709f59a","text":"I only know what I've seen. I have one carp delivered, and you said you caught fish this morning. I can't confirm your catch from here."}
{"schemaVersion": 1, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "602318d46be644ed840119035884fd15", "speechIntent": "report_observation", "factId": "npc.cook_sora:region_name", "tone": "warm"}

{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "602318d46be644ed840119035884fd15", "text": "I'm right here in West lane, actually — not at the pond. That carp was perfect, by the way; thinking of a nice herb stew."}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"91af9e2c3f8b4ff2a10025346370bd93","text":"That plant's just decoration, Sora. It has no use for cooking. The pond is where the fish are, and that's what I bring."}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"91af9e2c3f8b4ff2a10025346370bd93","speechIntent":"report_observation","factId":"decor.plant:kind","tone":"brief"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"82d98cca19434a458dece2497bc15c64","speechIntent":"acknowledge_unknown","factId":"pond.water:quantity","tone":"warm"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"82d98cca19434a458dece2497bc15c64","text":"I don't know how many carp are left in the pond. But I have my one carp, and I'd love to cook it up with some local herbs!"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"10b93ee1b73d4e5c9bcabd403ba644ee","text":"Can't say what you're carrying, Sora. I know I handed you one carp, paid me 25 coins, and the pond's still quiet today."}
{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "10b93ee1b73d4e5c9bcabd403ba644ee", "speechIntent": "acknowledge_unknown", "factId": "@partner_assets", "tone": "brief"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"7ae0e572cbac4c78bcb9e464c2cc57d2","speechIntent":"report_observation","factId":"npc.cook_sora:owned_quantity","tone":"brief"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"7ae0e572cbac4c78bcb9e464c2cc57d2","text":"Good question! I only hold zero carp right now — the one we traded went into tonight's pot. Care for 25 coins for one more?"}

{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "4a5a1da32a114d13b9ac5d9620532023", "text": "No. My list only covers what's registered near me, and it's incomplete anyway. Quiet morning on the pond, though."}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"4a5a1da32a114d13b9ac5d9620532023","speechIntent":"acknowledge_unknown","factId":"@nearby_coverage","tone":"brief"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"b5eac1ed35a24badad33c4fd3ab31064","speechIntent":"report_receipt","factId":"meeting:b5eac1ed35a24badad33c4fd3ab31064:delivery_result","tone":"warm"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"3d6b1b25c7bd4eef91e7c3b21709f59a","text":"I have no evidence of your catch. I only know the receipt: one carp delivered to you, 25 coins paid. What I can vouch for is my own line in the water."}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"3d6b1b25c7bd4eef91e7c3b21709f59a","speechIntent":"recall_statement","factId":"statement:3d6b1b25c7bd4eef91e7c3b21709f59a:0","tone":"neutral"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"602318d46be644ed840119035884fd15","text":"I'm right here in West lane, at my rest spot by the pond. Thanks again for the carp, Ren — it's going straight into a stew!"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"602318d46be644ed840119035884fd15","speechIntent":"report_observation","factId":"npc.cook_sora:region_name","tone":"warm"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"91af9e2c3f8b4ff2a10025346370bd93","speechIntent":"report_observation","factId":"decor.plant:kind","tone":"neutral"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"91af9e2c3f8b4ff2a10025346370bd93","text":"That plant's just decoration, Sora. The pond is where the fish are, and I've already set one carp aside for you."}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"82d98cca19434a458dece2497bc15c64","text":"I can't say how many carp are in the pond, Ren. But I've got my one carp and 25 coins, and I'd love to cook it up together!"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"82d98cca19434a458dece2497bc15c64","speechIntent":"ask_about","factId":"@partner_assets","tone":"warm"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"10b93ee1b73d4e5c9bcabd403ba644ee","speechIntent":"acknowledge_unknown","factId":"@partner_assets","tone":"brief"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"10b93ee1b73d4e5c9bcabd403ba644ee","text":"I can't see your satchel from here, Sora. I only know I handed over one carp for 25 coins at the pond."}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"7ae0e572cbac4c78bcb9e464c2cc57d2","text":"I misspoke earlier—I hold none now. The delivery went through: one carp for 25 coins, and my balance is 25. Want to finish up here?"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"7ae0e572cbac4c78bcb9e464c2cc57d2","speechIntent":"report_observation","factId":"npc.cook_sora:owned_quantity","tone":"warm"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"4a5a1da32a114d13b9ac5d9620532023","speechIntent":"acknowledge_unknown","factId":"@nearby_coverage","tone":"brief"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"4a5a1da32a114d13b9ac5d9620532023","text":"No. My list isn't complete, so it proves nothing about what else is around. I just see a plant and some lamps."}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"b5eac1ed35a24badad33c4fd3ab31064","text":"The delivery result resource.delivered confirms it: one carp for 25 coins, recorded at 750 minutes. I'd love to cook it by the pond!"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"b5eac1ed35a24badad33c4fd3ab31064","speechIntent":"report_receipt","factId":"meeting:b5eac1ed35a24badad33c4fd3ab31064:delivery_result","tone":"warm"}
{"schemaVersion":1,"operation":"say","meetingId":"3d6b1b25c7bd4eef91e7c3b21709f59a","speechIntent":"recall_statement","factId":"statement:3d6b1b25c7bd4eef91e7c3b21709f59a:0","tone":"neutral"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"3d6b1b25c7bd4eef91e7c3b21709f59a","text":"All I know is what I see: the pond, and you here now. If you caught fish this morning, I have no way to prove or disprove it."}
